text:
alice: Quick heads-up — onboarding sample app started failing in edge preview after we tightened package exports. Error: 
`SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` during start.

ben: That usually means a CJS loader picked up an .mjs. Did we remove main/module fallbacks? Paste package.json snippet please.

alice: snippet: `{"name":"@redwood/onboard","version":"1.0.0","exports":{"./feature":{"import":"./dist/feature.mjs","require":"./dist/feature.cjs"}},"types":"dist/index.d.ts"}`

carol: Yep — no root export (".") and no `./package.json` listed. Bundlers and some edge runtimes will resolve subpath to import entry if exports are incomplete, leading CJS processes to choke on `export` syntax.

ben: Quick mitigation: add explicit root export and `./package.json` entry plus top-level `main`/`module`. Example: "exports":{".":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"./package.json":"./package.json","./feature":{...}} and add "main":"dist/index.cjs","module":"dist/index.mjs".

carol: Also ensure the tarball includes both .cjs/.mjs and `.d.ts` files. Add a smoke test that installs from `npm pack` and verifies `require()` and `import()` consumers.

alice: I'll open a tiny patch and publish a canary, run `npm pack` locally and re-run sample-app in edge preview. CI flagged the failure: dev-bot reported sample-app edge matrix 3/3 failed.

dev-bot: CI: sample-app integration  failed on edge-worker. link: internal/ci/54321.

ben: Long-term: add an exports-change checklist to devex docs (smoke on Node12/14/16/18, Bun, edge runtimes, `npm pack`, bundler checks). Also update onboarding docs to show both `require` and `import` examples.

alice: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/701 — includes exports fallback, main/module, and smoke test. Will update here when CI finishes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
